''See also: [[Shen Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Reigan Shen]] is a powerful [[Monarch]] and the leader of [[House Shen]]. Originally a lion, he possesses immense physical strength and a regal appearance characterized by a white-gold mane and beard. He is known for his mastery of space, [[soulfire]] control, and [[willpower]], which he uses to manipulate reality and navigate [[Way|the Way]]. Shen is a highly capable individual, noted as perhaps the only [[Monarch]] with the ability to create a replacement for the [[Soulforge]]. His history includes serving as a [[Herald]] and possessing a connection to the [[Void Icon]], having absorbed the [[Soulsmith inheritance]] of [[Ozmanthus Arelius]]. As a [[Monarch]], he holds [[Authority|authority]] over labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth and possesses various [[Abidan]] artifacts and powerful weapons, including city-destroying tools and [[Monarch]]-level launchers. While he can appear ostentatious—often utilizing golden pedestals or jeweled goblets—he is also capable of traveling in a rugged, weathered state. Throughout various conflicts, he has engaged in alliances and battles alongside other powerful figures, demonstrating both immense greed and a drive for recognition.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Shen wears black robes featuring a [[white badge]] on his chest. His eyes consist of white circles set within pools of blackness, and he possesses a pale right hand.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Shen is an active participant in decision-making processes. He is a figure whom [[Yerin]] and [[Malice]] no longer require.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Shen is connected to [[Yerin]] and [[Malice]], as they are individuals who no longer have a need for him. He is also addressed by the [[Void Sage]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A potential advanced [[sacred artist]], Shen utilizes mastery of space to wrestle portals open. He can project orange energy from his [[sword]], summon a shield, and utilize city-destroying weapons or techniques that threaten those living below [[Sacred Valley]].}}
